## to create healthier futures.

reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.

to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market

[ Meet Cencora ][86]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

  We are a trusted source for over 2.5 million customers since 2000. To learn more about Vitality

* [Happy Customers]
  
  ###### Happy Customers
  
  See our customer testimonials or our excellent customer reviews on Trustpilot, Reseller ratings
  and the Better Business Bureau.

When you’re shopping for medical supplies, the last thing you want to do is navigate multiple
stores, fight against budget restraints, and deal with complicated pickup or delivery requirements.
At Vitality Medical, we work hard to take the stress out of purchasing medical supplies, letting you
worry less about your purchase and more about the health of you or your loved one.
* ## Delivering Quality and Reliability
  
  Vitality Medical stands out as a leading online destination for discount medical supplies and
  equipment, offering over 100,000 products from reputable brands. Since 2000, over 2.5 million
  customers have trusted Vitality Medical for their healthcare needs, conveniently browsing and
  purchasing a wide range of medical supplies online. This has made Vitality Medical a go-to source
  for both consumers and resellers. Our commitment to quality and service is recognized by top
  ratings, including an [**A+ from the Better Business Bureau**][98] and a [**4.2-star rating on
  Google**][99]. Discover more about our success on [**Bloomberg**][100] or [**Inc. 5000**][101],
  and read [**testimonials**][102] on [**Trustpilot**][103] and [**Reseller Ratings**][104].
* ## Committed to Affordable Medical Supplies
  
  At Vitality Medical, affordability and quality go hand in hand. Our product experts are dedicated
  to helping customers find medical supplies online that fits both their needs and their budgets.
  We’re committed to offering the best prices. **If you find a lower price elsewhere, we'll match
  it**. Our national network of warehouses, stocked with top-tier brands, guarantees fast and
  reliable shipping. Many of these warehouses are strategically located near major metropolitan
  areas, ensuring that your medical supplies arrive quickly and cost-effectively, right when you
  need them. Sign up for our newsletter to stay informed about exclusive sales and promotions. We
  regularly offer discounts on both innovative new products and everyday essentials.
* ## Why Choose Vitality Medical
  
  Navigating the world of home medical supplies can be overwhelming. Vitality Medical is here to
  guide you every step of the way. Our customer service team receives regular training to ensure
  they can answer all your product-related questions. If an item is out of stock, our team will go
  the extra mile to find it, underscoring our commitment to helping you **Add Vitality to Your
  Life**.
  
  For purchasing agents in hospitals, caregiver facilities, or retail, our [Business to
  Business][105] section offers tailored solutions and information to meet your specific needs.
  
  When you choose Vitality Medical as your online medical supply store, you’re choosing convenience,
  dependability, and expertise. Explore our products today to find the equipment you need. You can
  also [contact our team][106] to learn more about our products, get help navigating our
  collections, and make an informed, confident purchase.

When you’re shopping for medical supplies, the last thing you want to do is navigate multiple
stores, fight against budget restraints, and deal with complicated pickup or delivery requirements.
At Vitality Medical, we work hard to take the stress out of purchasing medical supplies, letting you
worry less about your purchase and more about the health of you or your loved one.
* ## Delivering Quality and Reliability
  
  Vitality Medical stands out as a leading online destination for discount medical supplies and
  equipment, offering over 100,000 products from reputable brands. Since 2000, over 2.5 million
  customers have trusted Vitality Medical for their healthcare needs, conveniently browsing and
  purchasing a wide range of medical supplies online. This has made Vitality Medical a go-to source
  for both consumers and resellers. Our commitment to quality and service is recognized by top
  ratings, including an [**A+ from the Better Business Bureau**][98] and a [**4.2-star rating on
  Google**][99]. Discover more about our success on [**Bloomberg**][100] or [**Inc. 5000**][101],
  and read [**testimonials**][102] on [**Trustpilot**][103] and [**Reseller Ratings**][104].
* ## Committed to Affordable Medical Supplies
  
  At Vitality Medical, affordability and quality go hand in hand. Our product experts are dedicated
  to helping customers find medical supplies online that fits both their needs and their budgets.
  We’re committed to offering the best prices. **If you find a lower price elsewhere, we'll match
  it**. Our national network of warehouses, stocked with top-tier brands, guarantees fast and
  reliable shipping. Many of these warehouses are strategically located near major metropolitan
  areas, ensuring that your medical supplies arrive quickly and cost-effectively, right when you
  need them. Sign up for our newsletter to stay informed about exclusive sales and promotions. We
  regularly offer discounts on both innovative new products and everyday essentials.
* ## Why Choose Vitality Medical
  
  Navigating the world of home medical supplies can be overwhelming. Vitality Medical is here to
  guide you every step of the way. Our customer service team receives regular training to ensure
  they can answer all your product-related questions. If an item is out of stock, our team will go
  the extra mile to find it, underscoring our commitment to helping you **Add Vitality to Your
  Life**.
  
  For purchasing agents in hospitals, caregiver facilities, or retail, our [Business to
  Business][105] section offers tailored solutions and information to meet your specific needs.
  
  When you choose Vitality Medical as your online medical supply store, you’re choosing convenience,
  dependability, and expertise. Explore our products today to find the equipment you need. You can
  also [contact our team][106] to learn more about our products, get help navigating our
  collections, and make an informed, confident purchase.

# **One Provider
# for Global Health
# Insurance and Benefits
# **

International health insurance for Individuals and Employers.
Find the right plan for you below:

## **International Health Insurance for you and your family**

Working, studying or living abroad? Our international health insurance plans help protect expat
individuals, professionals, students and families as they work and live abroad. Explore our plans
and choose the international expat healthcare cover that’s perfect for you. Only away for less than
a year? Discover our short-term private health insurance for individuals and families.
[ INTERNATIONAL HEALTH INSURANCE (12+ MONTHS) ][106]
[ SHORT TERM HEALTH INSURANCE (3-9 MONTHS) ][107]
[Young women smiling at camera]

## **Consistent cover for your employees**

We understand that in today's globalized world, businesses often have employees spread across
different regions.  With our regional plans, you can ensure consistent and reliable coverage for
your employees worldwide. Our Summit plans are designed to meet the unique healthcare needs of each
region, while also ensuring compliance with local regulations. We provide administration services,
cover for insurance risks, or a combination of both.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.
[ FIND OUT MORE ][117]

## **
## Next Generation Healthcare**

Solutions for a healthier future -
Our mission is to make access to quality healthcare easier,
giving you peace of mind and confidence in tomorrow.

 

 

[ Our Social Responsibility ][118]

## **Why choose us as your trusted international health insurer?**

### **#1**

#### **Best in class experiences**

Financially strong company with A+ Superior, A.M. Best rating. Number 1 insurance brand by
Interbrand for the seventh year running.

### **2M+**

#### **Worldwide expertise**

Growing network of over 2 million quality medical providers, settling medical bills directly with
the provider for most in-patient treatments.

### **24/7**

#### **Support**

Always on: 24/7 multilingual Helpline and Emergency Assistance Services.

### **48hrs**

#### **Quick and efficient**

Fully completed medical claims processed within 48 hours.

## **Wellness Hubs**

At Allianz, we believe in empowering you to lead a life of balance and vitality. That's why we're
thrilled to introduce our Wellness Hubs; your go-to resource for comprehensive health and wellness
support. Whether you're looking to enhance your mental wellbeing, prioritise women's health, cancer
support, nutrition, improve sleep hygiene, manage weight effectively, or explore the secrets to
longevity, our hubs are designed to guide you every step of the way.

[ Find out more ][119]

## **Support**

**
**

### **Support**

This is your toolbox, with many resources you might need, whether you're an insured member, an
employer, an intermediary or a healthcare provider.

[VIEW OUR RESOURCES][127]

**
**

### **FAQs**

Browse the topics below to find the answers for the most frequently asked questions. 

[ ANSWER YOUR QUESTION][128]

**
**

### **Contact**

If you're interested in getting international health insurance for you and your family, we'd be
delighted to speak with you by phone or email. You can also arrange for us to call you at the time
it suits you best.
[ LET US CALL YOU ][129]
[ +353 1 514 8480 ][130]
[Two women talking at work]

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

Get answers to your questions quickly and easily with our handy FAQs.

[ Read the full FAQs ][131]

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

## **
## Olympic & Paralympic Movements**

Allianz is proud to be the Worldwide Insurance Partner of
the Olympic and Paralympic Movements from 2021-2032.
[ Find out more ][133]

## **Latest News**

### **
### New Sleep Support Hub**

Struggling with sleep? Our new **Sleep Support Hub** is here to help. Discover practical tips,
expert articles, and wellbeing tools designed to support better rest - from winding down at night to
understanding common sleep challenges and available support. Small changes can make a big difference
to how you feel, day and night.
[ Check the Hub ][134]

### **Orient Insurance and Allianz Partners launch Sphera International Healthcare plans**

New plans aim to simplify international healthcare coverage for globally mobile residents across
Dubai and the Northern Emirates.
[ More Information ][135]

### **Allianz Partners strengthens its Health line of business with four senior appointments**

Allianz Partners, a world leader in insurance and assistances services, has announced four senior
appointments across its Health line of business. 

[ Read more ][136]

### **Allianz Partners announces two key board appointments**

Allianz Partners, a world leader in B2B2C insurance and assistance, has announced two strategic
leadership appointments to its Board of Management.

[ Read more ][137]

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

## Did you know?

## IT'S NOT TABOO.

Have you talked about your ‘lady parts’ with an expert lately? Come spend an hour with us discussing
solutions to achieve optimal quality of life.

[ Make an Appointment ][38]

###### We specialize in...

##### female pelvic medicine, reconstructive surgery, and minimally invasive gynecologic surgery

At Brazosport Women’s Health, we combine passion and professionalism to provide state-of-the-art
gynecological and urogynecological care right here in the heart of Brazoria County at our office in
Lake Jackson. We are skilled in the diagnosis and treatment of a wide range of female pelvic health
disorders, as well as preventative care and general gynecology.
Pelvic Organ Prolapse

At Brazosport Women’s Health, we combine passion and professionalism to provide state-of-the-art
gynecological and urogynecological care right here in the heart of Brazoria County at our office in
Lake Jackson. We are skilled in the diagnosis and treatment of a wide range of female pelvic health
disorders, as well as preventative care and general gynecology. [Learn More… ][39]

Incontinence

Incontinence is the involuntary loss of control of bladder and/or bowel function that results in the
leakage of urine and or stool. At BWH, we specialize in diagnosing and treating this common,
life-altering, and often embarrassing problem. [Learn More… ][40]

Bleeding & Pain

Abnormal, unusual, or severe vaginal bleeding and/or pelvic pain are cause for concern. If you are
experiencing either or both issues, then we encourage you to schedule an appointment at BWH as soon
as possible.[ Learn More… ][41]

Vaginal Reconstruction & Restoration

The providers at Brazosport Women’s Health are experts in understanding, diagnosing, and treating
disorders and problems related to vaginal health. [Learn More… ][42]

Body Contouring

Our provider team will work with you to develop a comprehensive plan for overall wellness. At BWH we
offer body contouring treatments with Evolve. Sessions using this non-invasive and painless body
sculpting technology will help you achieve your aesthetic goals. [Learn More… ][43]

Preventative Health Care

At BWH, our approach to women’s health is comprehensive, and we are here to help our patients
achieve optimal health throughout their lives. We believe in preventing disease by promoting overall
wellness. [Learn More… ][44]

Sexual Health & Improvement

Brazosport Women’s Health is a place where women can feel safe, comfortable, listened to, and
understood. Dr. Samatha Kadiyala founded BWH in 2010 because she believes that women should have
access to trusted, expert care locally and should not have to travel great distances to receive
state-of-the-art, discreet women’s healthcare. [Learn More… ][45]

[ [PWH Logo 2C - Home 3] ][46]

## ABOUT PRIVIA WOMEN’S HEALTH

We’re proud members of Privia Women’s Health, where we give caring for women the prominence it
deserves.

We take a thoroughly modern and holistic approach to women’s health. We know what women, and their
bodies, have to go through and we make sure every woman gets the individual care she needs.

Privia Women’s Health makes it easy for you to make your health a priority. We provide some of the
latest advances in medicine, including innovative technologies, personalized care and a
patient-centered approach to make sure every woman receives the individual care she needs. Your
health is your journey and no matter where you are, we’re here to help.

[ Visit Privia Website ][47]

Looking for a local Medspa? 

At Urban Well the experience is aesthetically and scientifically designed to revitalize the whole
you—skin, body, mind, and spirit. The result is optimized wellbeing and balance.

[ Visit Their Website ][48]
[urban well logo full color square - Home 5]

PROUD TO BE PART OF [PRIVIA MEDICAL GROUP][49]

[ ][50]

## [(979) 266-9544][51]

208 Oak Dr S #300
Lake Jackson, TX

 

Serving the women of
Brazoria County for over 10 years. Providing the

## Did you know?

## IT'S NOT TABOO.

Have you talked about your ‘lady parts’ with an expert lately? Come spend an hour with us discussing
solutions to achieve optimal quality of life.

[ Make an Appointment ][38]

###### We specialize in...

##### female pelvic medicine, reconstructive surgery, and minimally invasive gynecologic surgery

At Brazosport Women’s Health, we combine passion and professionalism to provide state-of-the-art
gynecological and urogynecological care right here in the heart of Brazoria County at our office in
Lake Jackson. We are skilled in the diagnosis and treatment of a wide range of female pelvic health
disorders, as well as preventative care and general gynecology.
Pelvic Organ Prolapse

At Brazosport Women’s Health, we combine passion and professionalism to provide state-of-the-art
gynecological and urogynecological care right here in the heart of Brazoria County at our office in
Lake Jackson. We are skilled in the diagnosis and treatment of a wide range of female pelvic health
disorders, as well as preventative care and general gynecology. [Learn More… ][39]

Incontinence

Incontinence is the involuntary loss of control of bladder and/or bowel function that results in the
leakage of urine and or stool. At BWH, we specialize in diagnosing and treating this common,
life-altering, and often embarrassing problem. [Learn More… ][40]

Bleeding & Pain

Abnormal, unusual, or severe vaginal bleeding and/or pelvic pain are cause for concern. If you are
experiencing either or both issues, then we encourage you to schedule an appointment at BWH as soon
as possible.[ Learn More… ][41]

Vaginal Reconstruction & Restoration

The providers at Brazosport Women’s Health are experts in understanding, diagnosing, and treating
disorders and problems related to vaginal health. [Learn More… ][42]

Body Contouring

Our provider team will work with you to develop a comprehensive plan for overall wellness. At BWH we
offer body contouring treatments with Evolve. Sessions using this non-invasive and painless body
sculpting technology will help you achieve your aesthetic goals. [Learn More… ][43]

Preventative Health Care

At BWH, our approach to women’s health is comprehensive, and we are here to help our patients
achieve optimal health throughout their lives. We believe in preventing disease by promoting overall
wellness. [Learn More… ][44]

Sexual Health & Improvement

Brazosport Women’s Health is a place where women can feel safe, comfortable, listened to, and
understood. Dr. Samatha Kadiyala founded BWH in 2010 because she believes that women should have
access to trusted, expert care locally and should not have to travel great distances to receive
state-of-the-art, discreet women’s healthcare. [Learn More… ][45]

[ [PWH Logo 2C - Home 3] ][46]

## ABOUT PRIVIA WOMEN’S HEALTH

We’re proud members of Privia Women’s Health, where we give caring for women the prominence it
deserves.

We take a thoroughly modern and holistic approach to women’s health. We know what women, and their
bodies, have to go through and we make sure every woman gets the individual care she needs.

Privia Women’s Health makes it easy for you to make your health a priority. We provide some of the
latest advances in medicine, including innovative technologies, personalized care and a
patient-centered approach to make sure every woman receives the individual care she needs. Your
health is your journey and no matter where you are, we’re here to help.

[ Visit Privia Website ][47]

Looking for a local Medspa? 

At Urban Well the experience is aesthetically and scientifically designed to revitalize the whole
you—skin, body, mind, and spirit. The result is optimized wellbeing and balance.

## About DOC2US®

Introducing DOC2US, Your Trusted Online Doctor. With its name synonymous to “talk to us”,
DOC2US is a mobile application that allows you to talk to a doctor or any healthcare
professionals via text chat at any time and from anywhere.

### WHY DOC2US®?

We often find ourselves desperate for a professional medical practitioner’s advice at a time when it
seems most inconvenient. Troublesome symptoms that make us question their severity and if relied
solely on the internet, we can almost be certain that it is the bleakest ailment that has struck us.
The question that always seem to be lingering on our minds are: How severe is the situation and
which doctor should I seek opinion from?

However, the idea of braving the weather and traffic, proceeding to find a car park, before joining
others in the long queue then finally paying expensive consultation fees just to ask a simple
question “What is wrong with me?” is barely worth the effort. Here’s where DOC2US comes into play –
connecting you to a healthcare professional and get advice instantly via a simple platform.

adapt to advancements to meet the needs of our customers worldwide.

customized advice on our contact page.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

translational and clinical research][97].

## OMRON connect

The next generation OMRON connect US/CAN/EMEA app is here and it syncs with every one of our
connected blood pressure monitors and select body composition monitors! This app release features
expanded insights and new look and feel for monitoring your heart health. By wirelessly connecting
via **Bluetooth™**, you can easily upload, store and even share your heart history data with family
or physicians. And it even keeps track of your weight—so you can achieve your broader health goals.

connected blood pressure monitors and select body composition monitors! This app release features

via **Bluetooth™**, you can easily upload, store and even share your heart history data with family
or physicians. And it even keeps track of your weight—so you can achieve your broader health goals.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

trust.

#### How We Can Help You

[how_we_can_help_you-img-b1]

Trinity Medical GP Clinic is part of an established medical institution serving patients across the
country. Whether you need a same-day GP appointment, in-clinic diagnostics, or fast-track access to
specialist imaging, everything is available in one place – without referral delays or waiting lists.

Our consultations are unhurried and focused on clarity. We take the time to listen carefully,
understand your concerns, and offer thoughtful, evidence-based medical guidance.

[ Explore Our Services ][66]

#### Care You Can Trust

[care_you_can_trust-img-b1]

Trinity Medical GP Clinic is part of Trinity Medical – home to one of the region’s most advanced
private diagnostic imaging centres. 

Our GP Clinic brings that same standard of care to primary medicine. Led by our experienced GP, Dr
Carrasco, with a philosophy rooted in traditional family medicine – trust, continuity, and sound
clinical judgement. We believe healthcare should feel personal, reassuring, and accessible, without
compromise.

[ About Us ][67]

#### Diagnostics & Scans

[Phlebotomy image website]

We offer a comprehensive range of testing and investigation to support timely and accurate
diagnosis.

In-clinic we offer ECG, 24-hour Blood pressure monitoring, comprehensive blood testing and more –
with results available within days. For specialist imaging including ultrasound, DEXA scan and
nuclear medicine, we provide fast-track access to Trinity Medical Imaging, our partner located
on-site.

[ Blood tests & Investigations ][68]

## On-Site Access to Specialist Imaging

Trinity Medical GP Clinic is located alongside, and partnered with, Trinity Medical Imaging – one of
the most advanced private nuclear medicine and diagnostic imaging centres in the region. Our
patients benefit from fast-track access to many scans, all on the same site. Simple in-house
referrals. No waiting weeks for a scan. Just answers, when you need them.

## Clinical Experience at the Core

Trinity Medical GP Clinic is led by Dr Maria Carrasco, a General Practitioner with over 25 years of
clinical experience. Dr Carrasco brings a wealth of expertise to Trinity Medical, offering thorough,
considered consultations backed by the full diagnostic capability of Trinity Medical.

Her vision for Trinity Medical is simple: to provide private GP care that feels calm, considered,
and genuinely personal – where patients are never rushed, and medical decisions are guided by
experience, clarity, and integrity.  

This is the kind of general practice where you know your doctor, and your doctor truly knows you.

[ Explore Our Team ][79]

## Our Facilities

Our clinic is designed to be accessible, calm, and welcoming for all patients. We aim to make every
visit straightforward and comfortable, with facilities that support mobility, privacy, and
wellbeing.

#### Disabled Access

The clinic offers step-free access and facilities suitable for patients with mobility needs. If you
have specific requirements or would like to discuss access in advance, our team will be happy to
help.

#### Comfortable Clinical Environment

We provide a quiet, professional setting where appointments are unhurried and patients feel at ease.

#### Free On-Site Parking

Free parking is available for all patients attending appointments.

#### Excellent Transport Links

We are a short walk from Carshalton Beeches train station, with regular direct services from London
Victoria and London Bridge. Local bus routes, including the 154 and S3, stop nearby.

#### Complimentary Refreshments

Tea, coffee, and biscuits are available for patients and visitors.

#### Supportive Team

Our clinical and administrative staff are committed to providing clear communication, respectful
care, and support throughout your visit.

## Find Out For Yourself

We welcome new patients and enquiries.

You can book an appointment online, visit us at our Carshalton clinic, or contact the team to
discuss your care. All enquiries are handled promptly and confidentially.

**Call Us** at **020 3137 8287**, or

**Submit our enquiry form below** and a member of the team will get back to you.

[ Book A GP Appointment ][80]

### Do I need to leave my NHS GP to see you?

No. You can and should remain registered with your NHS GP while accessing our private services. We
work alongside your NHS GP where appropriate and will always advise if NHS treatment is more
suitable for your needs.

#### How We Can Help You

[how_we_can_help_you-img-b1]

Trinity Medical GP Clinic is part of an established medical institution serving patients across the
country. Whether you need a same-day GP appointment, in-clinic diagnostics, or fast-track access to
specialist imaging, everything is available in one place – without referral delays or waiting lists.

Our consultations are unhurried and focused on clarity. We take the time to listen carefully,
understand your concerns, and offer thoughtful, evidence-based medical guidance.

[ Explore Our Services ][66]

#### Care You Can Trust

[care_you_can_trust-img-b1]

Trinity Medical GP Clinic is part of Trinity Medical – home to one of the region’s most advanced
private diagnostic imaging centres. 

Our GP Clinic brings that same standard of care to primary medicine. Led by our experienced GP, Dr
Carrasco, with a philosophy rooted in traditional family medicine – trust, continuity, and sound
clinical judgement. We believe healthcare should feel personal, reassuring, and accessible, without
compromise.

[ About Us ][67]

#### Diagnostics & Scans

[Phlebotomy image website]

We offer a comprehensive range of testing and investigation to support timely and accurate
diagnosis.

In-clinic we offer ECG, 24-hour Blood pressure monitoring, comprehensive blood testing and more –
with results available within days. For specialist imaging including ultrasound, DEXA scan and
nuclear medicine, we provide fast-track access to Trinity Medical Imaging, our partner located
on-site.

[ Blood tests & Investigations ][68]

## On-Site Access to Specialist Imaging

Trinity Medical GP Clinic is located alongside, and partnered with, Trinity Medical Imaging – one of
the most advanced private nuclear medicine and diagnostic imaging centres in the region. Our
patients benefit from fast-track access to many scans, all on the same site. Simple in-house
referrals. No waiting weeks for a scan. Just answers, when you need them.

## Clinical Experience at the Core

Trinity Medical GP Clinic is led by Dr Maria Carrasco, a General Practitioner with over 25 years of
clinical experience. Dr Carrasco brings a wealth of expertise to Trinity Medical, offering thorough,
considered consultations backed by the full diagnostic capability of Trinity Medical.

Her vision for Trinity Medical is simple: to provide private GP care that feels calm, considered,
and genuinely personal – where patients are never rushed, and medical decisions are guided by
experience, clarity, and integrity.  

This is the kind of general practice where you know your doctor, and your doctor truly knows you.

[ Explore Our Team ][79]

## Our Facilities

Our clinic is designed to be accessible, calm, and welcoming for all patients. We aim to make every
visit straightforward and comfortable, with facilities that support mobility, privacy, and
wellbeing.

The clinic offers step-free access and facilities suitable for patients with mobility needs. If you
have specific requirements or would like to discuss access in advance, our team will be happy to
help.

We provide a quiet, professional setting where appointments are unhurried and patients feel at ease.

#### Free On-Site Parking

Free parking is available for all patients attending appointments.

#### Excellent Transport Links

We are a short walk from Carshalton Beeches train station, with regular direct services from London
Victoria and London Bridge. Local bus routes, including the 154 and S3, stop nearby.

#### Complimentary Refreshments

Tea, coffee, and biscuits are available for patients and visitors.

#### Supportive Team

Our clinical and administrative staff are committed to providing clear communication, respectful
care, and support throughout your visit.

We welcome new patients and enquiries.

You can book an appointment online, visit us at our Carshalton clinic, or contact the team to
discuss your care. All enquiries are handled promptly and confidentially.

**Call Us** at **020 3137 8287**, or

priorities that will receive our special attention. PCNs were formed to provide support to groups of
GP practices working together with community, mental health, social care, pharmacy, hospital and
voluntary services in a local area. We build on existing primary care services  to enable greater
provision of proactive personalised, coordinated and more integrated health and social care for
people living close to home.

People aged 75 years and older, residents in care homes for older people, and those aged 6 months
and over with a weakened immune system will be offered a dose of COVID-19 vaccine this spring.

COVID-19 is more serious in older people and in people with certain underlying health conditions.
For these reasons, people aged 75 years and over, those in care homes, and those aged 6 months and
over with a weakened immune system are being offered a spring dose of COVID-19 vaccine.

People with a diagnosis of hypertension (high blood pressure) require regular monitoring. They
should have their blood pressure checked at least annually.


We know that in Hull there are many patients walking around with known hypertension whose blood
pressure is higher than we would like and, as such, they are at a higher risk of having a stroke or
heart attack. Please make sure you get your blood pressure checked when invited in by your practice.

[READ OUR FULL ARTICLE][53]

appointment. For more information, click below.

appropriate for referral, a referral to the Musculoskeletal Clinic may be offered initially.

[>> Joint Injections][55]

pregnancy after just one treatment. This service is open to patients aged 16+. To arrange an
appointment please contact your GP Practice. For further information, click below:

[   >> LARC][56]

A blood pressure test checks if your blood pressure is healthy, or if it's high or low. Blood
pressure is the term used to describe the strength with which your blood pushes on the sides of your
arteries as it's pumped around your body.You can check your blood pressure in your GP reception area
and hand the reading print-out to staff.

[>> Blood Pressure][57]

### **Social Prescribing**

Social Prescribing is a community-based service that enables GP practices to refer patients to a
range of services that offer support for social, emotional or practical needs. Through a link
worker, social prescribing connects patients to community groups and services. For more information,
please click below:

[>> social prescribing][60]

### **BeWell**

The Health & Lifestyle Practitioners are non-clinical practitioners located within your GP practice
who can support patients with making positive lifestyle changes including improving diet and
increasing physical activity levels. They  focus on the prevention of conditions such as
Cardiovascular Disease and Type 2 Diabetes. Please contact your GP practice if you would like to be
referred to the BeWell Service. For more information, please click below:


[>> BeWell][61]

### **Spirometry**

Spirometry is a simple, non-invasive procedure and common diagnostic test used to assess lung
function and detect various respiratory conditions, including asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary
disease (COPD), and pulmonary fibrosis. It does so by measuring the volume and flow of air that a
person can inhale and exhale. During a spirometry test, a patient breathes into a device called a
spirometer, which measures the volume and flow of air expelled from the lungs.

[>> Spirometry][62]

### **Extended Access**

Extended Access is an extension of your GP practice and offers routine and same day appointments
with a range of clinicians including GPs, Nurses and other Healthcare Professionals.  Our practices
within the PCN will be able to provide enhanced access appointments between the hours of 6.30pm to
8pm Mondays to Fridays and between 9am and 5pm Saturdays and Sundays.

[>> Extended Access][63]

### **Sleep**

Whether you're dealing with occasional sleep disturbances or chronic sleep issues, our team is here
to help. Through education, personalised assessments, and evidence-based interventions, we aim to
empower you to take control of your sleep health and experience the benefits of restorative sleep.
Explore our resources, connect with our practice teams, and take the first step towards better sleep
today. Together, we can work towards a healthier, happier, and more rested you.

[>> sleep][64]

### **Online Services**

All Venn GP Practices operate convenient ONLINE SERVICES which can be access via the practice's own
website. Requests for administrative support, prescription requests and links to non-urgent medical
advice portals can be accessed 24/7. Requests for clinical service by the medical staff at the
surgery are available during operating hours via Systmconnect. Non-urgent medical advice - including
dental support - can be obtained 24/7 through the NHS 111 service by dialing 111 or via 111 Online.
For medical emergencies, dial 999

### **Home Visiting Services**

Our Home Visiting Team consists of Advanced Care Nurse Practitioners. The team support all our
practices within the PCN by conducting home visits for housebound patients who are too unwell to
leave their home or patients within a care home. The team are supported by GPs within the practices.

[ WELCOME TO VENN PRIMARY CARE NETWORK][51]

Welcome to the website of Venn Primary Care Network (PCN).

Our family of local GP practices are working together to transform health services in the Hull area.
Whilst aiming to improve all aspects of health provision, we have identified some clear local
priorities that will receive our special attention. PCNs were formed to provide support to groups of
GP practices working together with community, mental health, social care, pharmacy, hospital and
voluntary services in a local area. We build on existing primary care services  to enable greater
provision of proactive personalised, coordinated and more integrated health and social care for
people living close to home. 

# SPRING COVID VACCINE

People aged 75 years and older, residents in care homes for older people, and those aged 6 months
and over with a weakened immune system will be offered a dose of COVID-19 vaccine this spring.

COVID-19 is more serious in older people and in people with certain underlying health conditions.
For these reasons, people aged 75 years and over, those in care homes, and those aged 6 months and
over with a weakened immune system are being offered a spring dose of COVID-19 vaccine.

[VACCINATION GUIDE][52]

# HYPERTENSION MONITORING

People with a diagnosis of hypertension (high blood pressure) require regular monitoring. They
should have their blood pressure checked at least annually.


We know that in Hull there are many patients walking around with known hypertension whose blood
pressure is higher than we would like and, as such, they are at a higher risk of having a stroke or
heart attack. Please make sure you get your blood pressure checked when invited in by your practice.

[READ OUR FULL ARTICLE][53]

# Venn PCN Services

### **Menopause **

To arrange an appointment please contact your own GP Practice requesting a referral to the Menopause
Clinic. An appointment will be arranged for a blood test. Once your results are available the GP
will review these. You will then receive a text message/phone call to arrange your initial
appointment. For more information, click below.

[ >> Menopause][54]

### **Joint Injections **

To arrange an appointment please contact your GP Practice requesting a referral to the Joint
Injection Clinic. An appointment will be arranged for you to see your GP. GP will assess if
appropriate for referral, a referral to the Musculoskeletal Clinic may be offered initially.

[>> Joint Injections][55]

### **LARC **

Long-acting reversible contraception (LARC) is the term used for birth control that helps prevent
pregnancy after just one treatment. This service is open to patients aged 16+. To arrange an
appointment please contact your GP Practice. For further information, click below:

[   >> LARC][56]

### **Blood Pressure**

A blood pressure test checks if your blood pressure is healthy, or if it's high or low. Blood
pressure is the term used to describe the strength with which your blood pushes on the sides of your
arteries as it's pumped around your body.You can check your blood pressure in your GP reception area
and hand the reading print-out to staff.

[>> Blood Pressure][57]

### **Musculoskeletal**

There is a twin-track process for musculoskeletal referrals. For certain conditions, patients can
self-refer via a triage portal. Alternatively, they can be assessed by their GP who will discuss the
most appropriate response for the presenting symptoms.

[>> Musculoskeletal][58]

### **FeNO**

FeNO testing can be arranged by your own GP practice. Fractional exhaled nitric oxide (FeNO) is a
non-invasive biomarker used in the diagnosis and management of airway inflammation, particularly in
asthma.

[>> FeNO][59]

### **Social Prescribing**

Social Prescribing is a community-based service that enables GP practices to refer patients to a
range of services that offer support for social, emotional or practical needs. Through a link
worker, social prescribing connects patients to community groups and services. For more information,
please click below:

[>> social prescribing][60]

### **BeWell**

The Health & Lifestyle Practitioners are non-clinical practitioners located within your GP practice
who can support patients with making positive lifestyle changes including improving diet and
increasing physical activity levels. They  focus on the prevention of conditions such as
Cardiovascular Disease and Type 2 Diabetes. Please contact your GP practice if you would like to be
referred to the BeWell Service. For more information, please click below:


[>> BeWell][61]

### **Spirometry**

Spirometry is a simple, non-invasive procedure and common diagnostic test used to assess lung
function and detect various respiratory conditions, including asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary
disease (COPD), and pulmonary fibrosis. It does so by measuring the volume and flow of air that a
person can inhale and exhale. During a spirometry test, a patient breathes into a device called a
spirometer, which measures the volume and flow of air expelled from the lungs.

[>> Spirometry][62]

### **Extended Access**

Extended Access is an extension of your GP practice and offers routine and same day appointments
with a range of clinicians including GPs, Nurses and other Healthcare Professionals.  Our practices
within the PCN will be able to provide enhanced access appointments between the hours of 6.30pm to
8pm Mondays to Fridays and between 9am and 5pm Saturdays and Sundays.

[>> Extended Access][63]

### **Sleep**

Whether you're dealing with occasional sleep disturbances or chronic sleep issues, our team is here
to help. Through education, personalised assessments, and evidence-based interventions, we aim to
empower you to take control of your sleep health and experience the benefits of restorative sleep.
Explore our resources, connect with our practice teams, and take the first step towards better sleep
today. Together, we can work towards a healthier, happier, and more rested you.

[>> sleep][64]

### **Online Services**

All Venn GP Practices operate convenient ONLINE SERVICES which can be access via the practice's own
website. Requests for administrative support, prescription requests and links to non-urgent medical
advice portals can be accessed 24/7. Requests for clinical service by the medical staff at the
surgery are available during operating hours via Systmconnect. Non-urgent medical advice - including
dental support - can be obtained 24/7 through the NHS 111 service by dialing 111 or via 111 Online.
For medical emergencies, dial 999

### **Home Visiting Services**

Our Home Visiting Team consists of Advanced Care Nurse Practitioners. The team support all our
practices within the PCN by conducting home visits for housebound patients who are too unwell to
leave their home or patients within a care home. The team are supported by GPs within the practices.

# What are PFDs?

Pelvic Floor Disorders (PFD) are a group of conditions that affect the pelvic floor due to weakened
pelvic muscles or tears in the connective tissue.

[ Learn More ][140]

# Pelvic Floor Patient Health Guide

Order Your Copy of the patient-focused book today!

[ Order Here! ][141]

## Find a Health Care Professional

Visit with a doctor to discuss your PFD symptoms.

[ Discover ][142]

## Tools for Patients

Resources to help prepare you for a visit with your provider.

[ Resources ][143]

## AUGS Patient Endowment Fund

This fund will sustain AUGS patient education programs in perpetuity—across the channels, formats,
and communities that best reach patients and caregivers now and into the future.

## Private Care at Welbeck

Showing 1 of 4 — Access care
Access care

## Fast access to exceptional care

At Welbeck, we provide fast access to leading healthcare professionals, as well as the most advanced
diagnostics and treatments available. Discover how to access private care at Welbeck with our
helpful step-by-step guide.

[Learn more][102]
[Woman entering Welbeck]
Find a specialist

## Choosing the right specialist for you

Finding the right specialist is an important step in your healthcare journey. We’re here to help you
feel confident and empowered in choosing the consultant best suited to your condition, priorities,
and expectations.

[Our specialists][103]
[Female consultant]
How to pay

## Paying for your care

Private healthcare can be paid for in two main ways: self-pay or through private health insurance.

At Welbeck, we accept both payment types, and our team is here to guide you through what to expect
and the steps to take before your appointment.

[Learn more][104]
[Receptionist]
FAQs

## How quickly can I be seen?

We aim to offer appointments as quickly as possible, and many services have same-day or next-day
availability. Waiting times vary depending on the appointment type, specialty, and consultant
availability, but our team will always offer the earliest suitable appointment.



## Can I book an appointment on behalf of someone else?

Yes. You can arrange an appointment for a family member, or someone you care for, just let us know
when you get in touch. We’ll need their details and consent to complete the booking, unless you're
their legal guardian or have power of attorney.  



## Can I request a chaperone?

Yes. If you’d like a chaperone to be present during your appointment, please let your centre know
before your appointment, and they’ll be happy to arrange this for you. You’re also welcome to bring
a partner, friend, or family member with you for your visit. There may be some cases where the
clinical setting requires your chaperone to wait in the waiting area for part of your visit, for
example, if you’re having imaging tests. Your centre will let you know in advance if this is the
case.



## What facilities are available while I wait?

All our waiting areas offer complimentary refreshments, including hot drinks and water. The spaces
are calm and comfortable, designed to help you relax before your appointment.



## Is Welbeck wheelchair accessible?

Yes. All our centres are fully wheelchair accessible, with step-free entry and lifts to every floor.



## Can I have interpreter support?

Yes. Let the centre know before your visit if you’d like an interpreter, and this can be arranged
for you through LanguageLine.

Interpretation is typically provided over the phone. If an in-person translator is preferred, this
can also be arranged, although this may be subject to an additional fee.

[See all FAQs][105]

## Choosing the right specialist for you

Finding the right specialist is an important step in your healthcare journey. We’re here to help you
feel confident and empowered in choosing the consultant best suited to your condition, priorities,
and expectations.

[Our specialists][103]
[Female consultant]
How to pay

## Paying for your care

Private healthcare can be paid for in two main ways: self-pay or through private health insurance.

At Welbeck, we accept both payment types, and our team is here to guide you through what to expect
and the steps to take before your appointment.

[Learn more][104]
[Receptionist]
FAQs

## How quickly can I be seen?

We aim to offer appointments as quickly as possible, and many services have same-day or next-day
availability. Waiting times vary depending on the appointment type, specialty, and consultant
availability, but our team will always offer the earliest suitable appointment.



## Can I book an appointment on behalf of someone else?

Yes. You can arrange an appointment for a family member, or someone you care for, just let us know
when you get in touch. We’ll need their details and consent to complete the booking, unless you're
their legal guardian or have power of attorney.  



## Can I request a chaperone?

Yes. If you’d like a chaperone to be present during your appointment, please let your centre know
before your appointment, and they’ll be happy to arrange this for you. You’re also welcome to bring
a partner, friend, or family member with you for your visit. There may be some cases where the
clinical setting requires your chaperone to wait in the waiting area for part of your visit, for
example, if you’re having imaging tests. Your centre will let you know in advance if this is the
case.



## What facilities are available while I wait?

All our waiting areas offer complimentary refreshments, including hot drinks and water. The spaces
are calm and comfortable, designed to help you relax before your appointment.



## Is Welbeck wheelchair accessible?

Yes. All our centres are fully wheelchair accessible, with step-free entry and lifts to every floor.



## Can I have interpreter support?

Yes. Let the centre know before your visit if you’d like an interpreter, and this can be arranged
for you through LanguageLine.

Interpretation is typically provided over the phone. If an in-person translator is preferred, this
can also be arranged, although this may be subject to an additional fee.
